intent.logline: On the last train, a night-shift cleaner folds an unsent letter into a paper boat.
intent.turn: rehearsed apology -> the decision to keep it to herself
intent.audience_knows: the carriage is empty and she will not send it

shots.purpose: Establish the emptiness and the letter in her hand.

emotion.contradiction: wide shot for a private emotion

framing.notes: she sits centre-left; two thirds of the carriage empty to the right

composition.value_masses: dark window band across the top, one cold fluorescent tube above her, wet black glass behind
composition.negative_space: the empty seat rows to frame right

camera.motivation: the emptiness is the subject; the camera refuses to help her
camera.end_frame: unchanged, her hand resting on the unfolded letter
camera.turn_frame: her hand stops moving; the letter lies flat on her knee

action.primary: She smooths the letter flat on her knee, then stops.
action.subtext: She is rehearsing the apology for the last time.

sound.diegetic: wheel rhythm, ventilation hum, a fluorescent buzz

transition_out.matches: the fluorescent buzz carries into S02

continuity: navy cleaner uniform, hair tied back

references.label: <Picture 1>
references.defines: the cleaner, her navy uniform, the empty carriage, the cold fluorescent tube, the wet black window
references.exclude: any text on the carriage window decals

storyboard.panel: empty carriage, she sits centre-left, the letter flat on her knee, two thirds of the frame empty

shots.purpose: Make the folding an act of care, not a plot device.

framing.notes: hands and letter at seat height; her out-of-focus jaw at the top edge

composition.value_masses: lit hands in the lower two thirds, dark window above, soft jaw line at the top

camera.end_frame: a small paper boat in her palm
camera.turn_frame: the thumbnail presses the crease; the boat holds its shape

light.key: overhead fluorescent, slightly warm on the paper

action.primary: She folds the letter twice and presses the crease.
action.subtext: This is the only part of the apology she can still control.

continuity: letter stays in her right hand

storyboard.panel: hands folding the letter at seat height, her soft jaw at the top edge, dark glass behind
arrows: small push arrow at the frame edge
storyboard.annotation: S02 · CU · low · push in · 3.0 s

shots.purpose: The decision, without a line of dialogue.

framing.notes: face in the left third, boat at the bottom edge

composition.value_masses: lit face left, black glass right, the boat a small bright shape at the bottom
composition.negative_space: the dark window occupying the right half

camera.motivation: she lifts the boat toward the window light
camera.start_frame: medium close, boat at the bottom edge
camera.end_frame: profile against black glass, hand flat over the pocket
camera.turn_frame: the boat leaves the window light and disappears into the pocket

light.key: fluorescent, passing lights raking the cheek

action.primary: She looks at the boat, then puts it in her coat pocket.
cues: thumb presses the pocket flap down
action.subtext: She is not giving up on the apology; she is deciding it is hers.

transition_out.matches: end on the hand over the pocket

storyboard.panel: face in the left third, the paper boat at the bottom edge, black window filling the right
arrows: push arrow toward the window light
storyboard.annotation: S03 · MCU · eye · push in · 4.0 s

beats.name: establish
beats.goal: put her alone with the letter
beats.knowledge_change: the carriage is empty and she is not going anywhere

beats.name: reveal
beats.goal: make the letter an object she can hold
beats.knowledge_change: the apology has been written and folded already

beats.name: turn
beats.goal: she decides not to send it
beats.knowledge_change: the letter will stay with her

rhythm.note: hold the wide carriage, tighten on the hands, hold the decision
